requirements_summary: Goal: replace brittle keyword-first search to reduce false negatives on long-tail products. Two-stage architecture desired: fast vector/keyword hybrid retrieval (tolerable p95 < 80ms) + lightweight learned reranker for top-10 with p95 end-to-end < 120ms. Must demonstrate cost per query < $0.002 at baseline and < $0.01 during BF bursts with autoscaling/burst pricing. Index scale: 8–12M vectors (512-d) with nightly rebuilds and incremental updates. Need deterministic fallbacks for capacity throttles and transparent per-route cost metrics.
